identificationModule.briefTitle: Adebrelimab Plus Chemotherapy, Bevacizumab and Fluzoparib in Platinum-Sensitive Relapsed Ovarian Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: Adebrelimab Plus Chemotherapy and Bevacizumab Induction Therapy Followed by Maintenance Therapy With Adebrelimab Plus Fluzoparib and Bevacizumab in Platinum-Sensitive Relapsed Ovarian Cancer (CHANGCHUN): A Single-Arm, Exploratory Study

leadSponsor.name: The First Hospital of Jilin University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The investigators explore the efficacy and safety of adebrelimab (PD-L1 inhibitor) plus chemotherapy and bevacizumab induction therapy followed by maintenance therapy with adebrelimab plus fluzoparib (PARP inhibitor)and bevacizumab in platinum-sensitive relapsed ovarian cancer.

armGroups.label: Experimental arm
interventionNames: Drug: Adebrelimab, paclitaxel, carboplatin, bevacizumab, fluzoparib

interventions.name: Adebrelimab, paclitaxel, carboplatin, bevacizumab, fluzoparib
interventions.description: Adebrelimab plus paclitaxel, carboplatin and bevacizumab induction therapy followed by maintenance therapy with adebrelimab plus fluzoparib and bevacizumab.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Twelve months after patients received their first antitumor drug therapy.

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The radiological evaluations will be performed once at the end of every 2 cycles within 6 cycles and once every 4 cycles after Cycle 6(each cycle is 21 days).

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progress Free Survival (PFS) in patients with complete response (CR)/partial response (PR) after induction chemotherapy.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: The time from the first dose of investigational product to the first progression of disease (PD) in radiological evaluation or death for any reason (whichever comes first), assessed up to 2 years .

secondaryOutcomes.description: Progress Free Survival (PFS) in patients with stable disease (SD) after induction chemotherapy.
